name: Manipur
intro: Loktak Lake and its floating Keibul Lamjao park, home of the Sangai deer; Kangla Fort and the women-run Ima Keithel in Imphal; the birthplace of modern polo; war memorials of 1891 and 1944; and the Naga hills of Ukhrul and Shirui.

trails.name: Imphal heritage
trails.note: Kangla, the women's market, polo and the royal temple.

trails.name: Loktak circuit
trails.note: Floating phumdis, Sangai deer and the INA's first flag.

trails.name: East of Imphal
trails.note: Polo statue, Andro village and 1891's last battle.
